title: README, project docs and image smoke test
description: Task 9.2 plus image runtime check. README.md: purpose, Discord bot setup (View Channel, Send Messages, Embed Links; token, channel ID), Wanderer map API key and SSE enablement on server AND map (wanderer.ltd has SSE disabled), env var table (CHAINSNIFFER_*, _FILE variants), docker run with state volume, limitations (10-minute backfill window, final-blow-only classification, one instance per map), vendorHash update procedure. Fill in Build & Test and Architecture Overview sections in both CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (keep them in sync).
acceptance_criteria: Running the built image with no env vars exits 2 and names the missing variables; documented nix build .#image / docker run commands work as written; nix flake check passes.

title: OCI container image (packages.image, checks.image)
description: Task 9.1 (image part). flake.nix packages.image = dockerTools.buildLayeredImage: contents cacert, Entrypoint ${packages.default}/bin/chainsniffer, Env SSL_CERT_FILE, User 65532:65532, Volumes /var/lib/chainsniffer owned by 65532 (fakeRootCommands), no other runtime files. Add checks.image so a broken image fails the gate. Spec: relay-runtime 'Container image'.
acceptance_criteria: nix build .#image succeeds; docker load < result && docker inspect shows non-root user and the /var/lib/chainsniffer volume (if docker is unavailable to the agent, inspect the image config JSON from the build instead); nix flake check passes.

title: Wire cmd/chainsniffer: startup, shutdown, end-to-end test
description: Task 8.2. main: load config (exit 2 on config errors, naming every bad var), slog per CHAINSNIFFER_LOG_LEVEL/FORMAT to stderr, log redacted config, load state, Discord startup check, run Wanderer client with relay handler. SIGINT/SIGTERM: stop reading, let in-flight post finish (<=10s), save state, exit 0. Fatal Wanderer/Discord errors exit 1. Info logs: startup, subscription, reconnect reasons, posted killmail id + classification. Spec: relay-runtime 'Structured logging', 'Graceful shutdown'.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end test against fake Wanderer, Discord and ESI httptest servers: two kills arrive, one filtered, one posted; restart against same state dir with a backfilled duplicate posts nothing; SIGTERM test exits 0 and saves state; config error exits 2; nix flake check passes.

title: Relay pipeline (internal/relay)
description: Task 8.1. Per envelope: killmail.Extract -> per killmail in order: skip if in state posted set -> filters (debug-log killmail_id + filter name) -> resolve system name -> Render -> Post -> state.MarkPosted. After the envelope: set cursor to envelope id and save state atomically. Exhausted-retry kills: log error, not marked, cursor still advances. Fatal post error stops the relay (returned to caller). Define small interfaces (Poster, Resolver, Store) in relay for fakes. Spec: killmail-filtering 'Duplicate suppression', 'Filter decision logging'; wanderer-event-stream 'Event ID tracking'; relay-runtime 'Durable state writes'. Design: 'Processing order and cursor semantics'.
acceptance_criteria: Tests with fake poster/resolver/store: order preserved; duplicates within and across envelopes posted once; cursor advances only after an envelope completes; exhausted kill not recorded but cursor advances; fatal error propagates; nix flake check passes.

title: Discord poster and startup check (internal/discord)
description: Tasks 7.3-7.4. Poster.Post(ctx, *discordgo.MessageEmbed) via discordgo ChannelMessageSendEmbed to configured channel; 429 handled by discordgo retry_after; 5xx/network errors retried with exponential backoff within a 5-minute budget (injectable) then return a 'gave up' error; RESTError 401 fatal (bad token); 403/404 fatal with hint 'bot needs View Channel, Send Messages, Embed Links'. Startup check: validate token, channel exists/visible, permissions when resolvable; open/close a zero-intent gateway session (design 'Discord: discordgo, REST plus a minimal gateway session'). Make the Discord API base URL overridable (discordgo endpoint vars) for tests. Keep to poster.go/startup.go; do not modify Render (separate bead). Spec: discord-killmail-posting 'Post to configured channel', 'Rate limit compliance', 'Transient failure retry', 'Fatal Discord errors', 'Startup channel check'.
acceptance_criteria: Tests against an httptest fake Discord API: success, 502 then success, exhausted budget returns give-up error, 429 then success, 403 fatal, unknown channel and bad token fatal at startup before any post; nix flake check passes.

title: Embed rendering and system-name resolver (internal/discord render, internal/universe)
description: Tasks 7.1-7.2. internal/universe: resolve solar_system_id via ESI GET https://esi.evetech.net/latest/universe/systems/{id}/ (base URL injectable), 3s timeout, cache successes only, fall back to numeric ID. internal/discord: pure Render(killmail, classification, systemName) *discordgo.MessageEmbed per design 'Embed layout': title '<ship> — <victim|corp>' linked to https://zkillboard.com/kill/<id>/, thumbnail images.evetech.net/types/<ship_type_id>/render?size=128, inline fields System/Value(412.5M ISK style)/Attackers/Victim/Final blow, colors loss 0xC0392B kill 0x27AE60 neutral 0x7F8C8D, footer Loss/Kill, timestamp kill_time; missing fields degrade gracefully. Spec: discord-killmail-posting 'Embed content', 'Links and images', 'System name', 'Classification styling'. Do not touch the poster (separate bead); put Render in its own file (render.go).
acceptance_criteria: httptest tests for resolver (hit, cached second call, timeout, 404); golden tests for Render (typical kill, loss, structure kill, minimal fields) and ISK formatting; nix flake check passes.

title: Environment configuration (internal/config)
description: Task 5.1. Parse all CHAINSNIFFER_* variables and defaults (spec relay-runtime: Connection configuration, Filter configuration, Runtime settings, Secrets from files, Secrets are never logged). _FILE variants for WANDERER_TOKEN and DISCORD_TOKEN (trim whitespace; both set = error). FRIENDLY_ONLY without any friendly IDs = error (killmail-filtering 'Friendly-only filter'). Comma lists tolerate spaces. Collect and report all errors at once. Secret type whose String/LogValue return [redacted]; a redacted summary for startup logging. Take env via a lookup func for testability.
acceptance_criteria: Table tests over env maps covering defaults, missing/invalid vars (all named), _FILE handling, both-set error, friendly-only misconfig; test that the slog summary contains no token; nix flake check passes.

title: Wanderer SSE stream client (internal/wanderer)
description: Tasks 6.1-6.4. Client.Run(ctx, cursor func() string, handle func(Envelope) error). Request GET {url}/api/maps/{map}/events/stream?events=map_kill[&last_event_id=cursor], Authorization: Bearer, Accept: text/event-stream; token never in URL/logs. Decode envelope {id,type,map_id,timestamp,payload(raw JSON)}; log 'connected'; skip malformed with warning; handle synchronously. Backoff 1s doubling to 60s cap, +/-20% jitter, reset after first event/keepalive; 90s stale watchdog via internal/sse activity callback; durations injectable. Fatal typed error for 401, 402, 403, 404 and 503 'SSE disabled' (plain-text 'Server-Sent Events are disabled on this server' or JSON code SSE_GLOBALLY_DISABLED), with actionable hints (SSE_DISABLED_FOR_MAP -> enable SSE in map settings). 429 (connection limits), other 503, 5xx, EOF, network errors retry. Spec: wanderer-event-stream (all). Design: 'Stream client loop', Context section for wire format.
acceptance_criteria: httptest.Server tests: request path/query/headers with and without cursor; stream with connected + 2 map_kill + malformed + keepalive delivers exactly the 2 kills in order; 503/closed stream reconnects with growing delays and correct last_event_id; silent server triggers reconnect; each fatal case returns fatal error; 429/plain 503/500 retry; nix flake check passes.

title: Relay state file (internal/state)
description: Task 4.1. state.json in a state dir: last_event_id + ordered posted killmail IDs bounded to 1000 with O(1) membership (ring+set). Atomic save (CreateTemp in same dir, fsync, rename); create dir if missing; corrupt file -> rename to state.json.corrupt, warn, empty state; unwritable dir -> error. Spec: relay-runtime 'Persistent relay state', 'Durable state writes', 'Unreadable state'.
acceptance_criteria: Tests in t.TempDir(): round-trip, bound/eviction order, corrupt-file handling, read-only directory error; nix flake check passes.

title: Killmail model, decoding, classification and filters (internal/killmail)
description: Tasks 3.1-3.3. Types for the map_kill payload; lenient decoding: only payload type killmail_update -> killmails[]; ignore kill_count/unknown; skip entries without integer killmail_id with a warning; all other fields optional (structure kills lack victim char). Fields per spec 'Killmail fields'. Classification loss/kill/neutral against friendly corp+alliance ID sets (victim precedence, final_blow_* for kill). Filter chain with injected clock: exclude NPC, min total_value (missing=0, >= passes), friendly-only (drop neutral), max kill age (missing/unparseable kill_time kept); each drop returns the filter name. Dedupe is NOT here (state/relay). Spec: killmail-filtering (all requirements except Duplicate suppression and logging).
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests covering every killmail-filtering scenario for extraction, fields, classification, NPC, min value, friendly-only and max age, using fixture JSON shaped like Wanderer's message_handler.ex output; nix flake check passes.

title: SSE reader package (internal/sse)
description: Tasks 2.1-2.2. Hand-written WHATWG SSE parser on bufio.Reader: io.Reader -> events {id, event, data}; blank-line dispatch, multi-line data joined with \n, ':' comment lines, CRLF/LF/CR, strip one leading space after colon. Activity callback fired on any bytes incl. comments (for the stale-connection watchdog). Spec: wanderer-event-stream 'SSE framing' (keepalive ignored, malformed handled upstream). Design: 'Hand-written SSE client instead of a library'.
acceptance_criteria: Table tests for each parsing rule plus a fixture matching Wanderer's format_sse_event output (connected, map_kill, ': keepalive'); keepalive-only input fires the activity callback and yields no events; nix flake check passes.

title: Go module, Nix build and flake check gate (incl. discordgo dependency)
description: Tasks 1.1-1.4 plus the discordgo dependency. flake.nix: add go, gopls, golangci-lint to devshell packages; packages.default = buildGoModule (CGO_ENABLED=0, ldflags -s -w, subPackages [cmd/chainsniffer], pinned vendorHash); checks.build (package; checkPhase runs go test ./...), checks.vet (go vet ./... with vendored modules), checks.golangci-lint, all offline. go.mod module github.com/Vapor-Lock/chainsniffer; stub cmd/chainsniffer/main.go printing version; .golangci.yml (default linters + gofmt). Add github.com/bwmarrin/discordgo to go.mod now (keep it via a placeholder file in internal/discord, e.g. doc.go with a blank import) so later parallel beads never touch go.sum/vendorHash. Document the vendorHash update procedure in a comment in flake.nix. git add new files before nix commands.
acceptance_criteria: nix build yields result/bin/chainsniffer; nix flake check passes; a misformatted Go file makes nix flake check fail (then revert); nix develop --command go version works.

title: add-killmail-relay-bot: Discord bot relaying in-chain Wanderer killmails
description:
Implement the add-killmail-relay-bot OpenSpec change: a Go service that subscribes to one Wanderer map's SSE stream (map_kill), filters/classifies killmails, posts them as embeds to one Discord channel, persists state for resume/dedupe, and ships as an OCI image built by the flake.
Source of truth: openspec/changes/add-killmail-relay-bot/{proposal.md,design.md,specs/*/spec.md}. Read design.md before starting (package layout, Wanderer wire format, decisions).
Do NOT tick openspec tasks; this epic replaces tasks.md.
Child beads are sized to fit a single session each; follow dependency order via bd ready.
